inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is calling for outright rejection of the proposed constitutional amendments that are reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. At a press conference, he denounced the Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 as an unacceptable move by those in power. This is a blatant structural effort by elites to entrench their control and block any path toward equality, which will only deepen the inequalities that have long oppressed working people and vulnerable groups. We must reject this outright and demand institutional reforms that prioritize social justice, labor rights, and protection for the marginalized over preserving power for the few.
